servicesSection.headline: Our core healthcare solutions
servicesSection.intro: Three services for rapid insight, practical deployment, and everyday access.

services.title: AI Health Screening
services.summary: Rapid health screening that helps identify potential risk signals early and guides next steps.
services.description: AI Health Screening uses machine learning and structured assessments to turn checkup data into clear insights. Clinics, outreach programs, and individuals can spot early indicators without slow bottlenecks.

bullets.label: Fast
bullets.text: Speeds up initial screening and risk flagging so follow-up can start sooner.

bullets.label: Anywhere
bullets.text: Works in clinics, health camps, and community settings.

bullets.label: Affordable and creative
bullets.text: Keeps preventive checks practical and scalable for wider populations.

services.title: Cardiopulmonary Image Diagnostic
services.summary: AI-assisted imaging support for heart and lung evaluations with clearer diagnostic workflows.
services.description: This service applies AI analysis to medical imaging such as chest X-rays to help clinicians review cardiopulmonary findings. It highlights areas of interest so teams can prioritize urgent cases faster.

bullets.label: Fast
bullets.text: Speeds up image review and prioritization for clinical decisions.

bullets.label: Anywhere
bullets.text: Supports hospitals, outpatient clinics, and decentralized care points.

bullets.label: Affordable and creative
bullets.text: Works with portable or existing imaging workflows without heavy new infrastructure.

services.title: Real-Time Health Monitoring
services.summary: Connected physiological tracking that follows vital health trends as they happen.
services.description: Real-Time Health Monitoring uses sensors, wearables, and digital platforms to track key metrics continuously. Care teams and individuals can notice changes earlier than occasional clinic snapshots alone allow.

bullets.label: Fast
bullets.text: Surfaces notable shifts in tracked parameters so support can follow.

bullets.label: Anywhere
bullets.text: Monitors people at home, on the move, or in remote locations.

bullets.label: Affordable and creative
bullets.text: Uses everyday connected hardware and analytics as a practical wellness layer.

AI-CARE
Engineering and Artificial Intelligence for Community Access, Research & Excellence

Three Flagship Technologies
• AI-Powered General Health Screening & Assessment. Advancing preventive health and intelligent risk assessment at the primary and community healthcare level.
• Next-Generation AI-Assisted Cardiopulmonary Screening. Developing accessible respiratory and cardiovascular health screening and early clinical assessment.
• Smart AI Healthy Ageing & Elderly Care. Holistic assessment, connected health monitoring with AI wearables, and community-based support for older adults.
